xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5020: Every parallel PR conflicts on architecture.md's last-verified line because agents append their issue id to it

plan.title: Every parallel PR conflicts on architecture.md's last-verified line because agents append their issue id to it
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Each codebase-map file under .overdeck/context/codebase/ ends with a <!-- last-verified --> footer. Agents prepend their issue id to it (architecture.md:358 carries 30+ ids; concerns.md has three id-list footers from union merges), so two parallel PRs always change the same line to different values and conflict. On 2026-11-04 this cost PAN-4947, PAN-4935, PAN-4956 and PAN-4950 repeated conflict-repair, verification and review rounds. The planner's scratch-repo git experiments show date-only alone fixes same-day mid-file edits but still conflicts on different dates and on end-of-file appends, because every PR bumps the footer.
narratives.Proposal: Rewrite every map footer to the date-only form <!-- last-verified: YYYY-MM-DD -->. Change the instructions in roles/plan.md, the /pan-map skill and the conflict-repair prompt: the footer holds only the date, never issue ids (provenance goes in commit messages); a correction to one statement leaves the date unchanged and only a full /pan-map refresh changes it; on a footer conflict keep the later date. Add scripts/lint-last-verified.sh (npm run lint:last-verified, appended to npm run lint so CI's core lint group runs it) that fails on any footer that is not date-only but accepts two date-only footers, plus a unit test. Update docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md and docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Making two end-of-file appends to architecture.md merge cleanly; that is a real content conflict.
- Adding merge=union to architecture.md, conventions.md or stack.md.
- A lint that counts footers or requires the footer to be the last line (a union merge can legally leave two date-only footers on main).
- Changing .gitattributes, the merge door, or pan sync-main.
- Shrinking architecture.md or concerns.md toward the 150-line target.
- Rewording any other part of the codebase-map files besides footer lines.

autoDecisions.summary: Stop the per-touch date bump: a correction to one statement leaves the footer unchanged; only a full /pan-map refresh changes the date.
autoDecisions.rationale: Scratch-repo git 2.43 merges show date-only footers still conflict when two PRs stamp different dates or when one PR appends at the end of the file while the other bumps the footer. Removing the bump takes the footer out of ordinary PR diffs, which is the issue's goal, and matches what last-verified means. It is one sentence at the three instruction sites the issue already edits.

autoDecisions.summary: The lint checks footer format only and never counts footers.
autoDecisions.rationale: concerns.md has merge=union; the merge door's server rebase can leave two date-only footers on main with no PR CI run between. lint is a required check on main and a red main empties the merge gate, so counting would turn main red on a legal merge.

autoDecisions.summary: Implement the guard as a bash lint script plus a fixture-based unit test, not a vitest test over the real map files.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the repo's lint-script pattern (lint-quarantine-audit.sh and its test), runs automatically in CI's core lint group via run-lint-group.mjs, and avoids adding a source-reading test.

autoDecisions.summary: Conflict repair keeps one footer with the later date.
autoDecisions.rationale: Makes the residual conflict case (two full refreshes, or branches older than this change) a mechanical resolution.

metadata.sizeJustification: The 9 subsystems are 11 files that each change by one to five lines (two map footers, two instruction sentences, one prompt string, two doc bullets) plus one new 40-line lint script and its test. They implement a single rule (date-only footer, no per-touch bump) that must land together: splitting into sibling issues would make each sibling a footer-touching PR that conflicts with the others, which is the bug this issue fixes.
